notes: Tag with team and infection variants is Party & Casual's childhood-game core, so Childhood Game is the preset with obstacle-maze dropped since nothing here is a hiding warren. The author settled the shape themselves by naming the summer map as the initial play space with sporty to follow as its own build, so this is one continuous bounded space rather than several, and it stays on P0: the genre note is explicit that continuous-space tag never needs the isolated stage and that forcing one would buy P4 for nothing. cover-los gives the chases sightline breakers, social-hub the gathering space that carries the genre for a multiplayer round game, and spawn-protected the evenly distributed start points that team tag and infection both need to open fairly on a shared map. Buying a pass for hand wraps is cosmetics and monetization with no geometry, so nothing was emitted for it.
